moa.t: Inhibits bacterial cell-wall synthesis, narrow spectrum (streptococci, meningococci, treponemes)

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Benzylpenicillin (Penicillin G), IV, 50 000 units/kg, 12 hourly for 10 days.
Benzylpenicillin (Penicillin G), IV, 50 000 units/kg/dose, 6 hourly for 4–6* weeks.
Benzylpenicillin (Penicillin G), IV, 100 000 units/kg/dose immediately, then 4 hourly for 7 days.

adverse_effects.t: Hypersensitivity, anaphylaxis, seizures with very high doses in renal failure, Jarisch–Herxheimer reaction
